name: Echos_of_Samsara
description: Plan: Makes permadeath into an interesting system with meta progression. When you die your inventory will be turned into a chest that could be found in future worlds and Your bases will be added into the spawn pool for structures. Currently: Makes a file with your inventory in it with the command /createecho file name is effected by deathcount number. Makes a file with your deathcount with the command /countechos. Increase deathcount with /incrementdeathcount.
